text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe I was able to run
mostly as planned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Without killing this momentum,
next up is—"
choice_data_list: The Japan Derby is finally here!
The Japan Derby is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just one month left until the Nippon Derby—
Train according to schedule, and...

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Super, toll, klasse, Flash!"

On the way back, Eishin Flash typed
"Derby review" into her smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's Umart Search. We can track what everyone currently thinks about the runners in real time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Satsuki Sho is over,
how have the looks directed at me changed...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...There are so many coming up,
we can barely keep track of them all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Win for the sake of the dreams that were broken!"
"Catch up to your rival this time!"...
Almost all of the cheering was for other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...How about
'Derby Eishin Flash'?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...The search returned 3,190 results. While they're mostly reviews, overall there are very few mentions of me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The Derby really is special to everyone.
Perhaps what matters most is the passion each individual brings to it.
choice_data_list: It's a special race for you too.
This is a special race for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ……For "everyone", that is.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Those who are currently being praised
have every reason to be.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Things really can't stay as they are...

After murmuring that, Eishin Flash
sank into silence for a while...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I am submitting this training schedule
aimed at overall skill improvement.”

The day after the Satsuki Sho, the revised schedule
Eishin Flash brought me was...
truly staggering.
choice_data_list: A mock race every single week?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To simulate actual race conditions,
we will hold an 18-runner, 2,400-meter race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The participant list is already prepared.
Every single one of them has GⅠ experience.
If you give the approval, I will go reach out to them.
choice_data_list: It puts too much strain on your body

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a mock race, it's still a race.
Doing it alongside regular training will be quite exhausting for her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, as I am now, I don't stand out above the rest... I must increase my chances of victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To achieve a flawless result at the Derby, the best thing I can do in this short amount of time... is gain more experience.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Ability may not grow overnight, but experience can be built up piece by piece.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "In that case, our only path to victory... is to widen the gap through more practice races."
Eishin Flash's explanation makes sense to an extent. However, it isn't realistic.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I need you to train me
until this schedule becomes something
we can truly call realistic.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I am still very inexperienced. On my own,
everything would simply end as an unattainable dream."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So I have a request for you, Trainer: please mold me into the perfect self worthy of fulfilling this flawless schedule.

"...Then now is the time to fulfill
my duty as a Trainer."
choice_data_list: Can I hold onto this matter for now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Until when is 'for now'?
As I mentioned earlier,
we don't have much time until the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll check back in with you about the mock race in two days.
Thank you for your time.
choice_data_list: (What I need is experience... If that's the case—)

text_block_list.text:
Our next goal, the Japanese Derby...
Before that, there's something that needs to be done.
